description: Static Transition Matrix: step-by-step micro-goals that move a user from their assessed Capacity x Tendency cell to their Optimal Baseline. Stage is chosen by weeks since onboarding; weekly limit = tendency.starting_weekly_limit x stage.limit_multiplier.

The Comfort-Buyer.habit_swap: Swap one delivery night a week for a batch-cooked meal, and leave online baskets for 24 hours before buying.

The Status-Seeker.habit_swap: Before any purchase over £30, ask: would I still buy this if nobody ever saw it?

The Experience-Junkie.habit_swap: Pre-load a fixed 'fun budget' onto a separate card for each weekend and leave the main card at home.

The Panic-Hoarder.habit_swap: Cap cash withdrawals at £20 and move anything above a one-month buffer into an easy-access savings pot.

stages.name: Stop the bleed
micro_goals: List every debt with its APR
Cancel one subscription you haven't used this month
Stay under the weekly watch limit 2 weeks in a row

stages.name: Debt avalanche
micro_goals: Pay £25 extra a week to the highest-APR debt
Keep wants under 25% of income

stages.name: First £500 buffer
micro_goals: Automate £20 a week into savings
Reach a £500 emergency buffer

stages.name: See where it goes
micro_goals: Check NatAware's flagged transactions every Sunday
Name your top two leak categories

stages.name: Plug the leaks
micro_goals: Stay under the weekly watch limit
Move £15 a week into a savings pot the day you're paid

stages.name: Build the buffer
micro_goals: Reach one month of rent as a buffer
Hit the savings % in your baseline for one full month

stages.name: Tighten the edges
micro_goals: Stay under the weekly watch limit
Review subscriptions

stages.name: Grow the gap
micro_goals: Raise automated savings by 2% of income
Build three months of essential costs as a buffer

stages.name: Spend with intent
micro_goals: Give every 'want' a planned budget line
Keep the buffer at six months - not twelve

stages.name: Put money to work
micro_goals: Move surplus above the buffer into long-term savings
Book one planned, guilt-free experience a month
